column1: # Phiogy's mark, drawn on the measures of the face Phiogy is set in:
# name, how many, and of which measure of the font. The measures are
# read from the font file by script/logo.py: `stem` (an upright stroke),
# `thin` (a lying one, the hyphen's height), `round` (how wide the o
# is), `drop` (how far the p goes under the line), `one` (1). Nothing
# here is a size by eye. The mark is the web Phiogy's (puikit:
# app/phiogy/mark.py): the letter o, a voice, with a tail that makes a
# How much of the picture is left clear round the mark.
# The tail: as thick as a stem, it leaves the o's foot half a stem in
# from its left side, drops half as far as the p goes under the line,
# and leans out by half a stem as it drops. Its ends are round.
